description: Insert and maintain file header comments, and generate function comments with parameter extraction.
config.title: File Header
config.customMade.desc: Custom fields for the file header comment. Supports git values such as 'git config user.name' and template variables such as '${now_year}'.
config.cursorMode.desc: Custom fields for function comments. The default fields are description, param and return.
config.configObj.desc: Detailed options for comment generation, auto add behaviour, language symbols and function parameter extraction.
